messages:
Dana: AtlasCorp POC: need a tiny Rust streaming example + a strict func/tool JSON pattern for payment calls. They're seeing TLS errors behind corp proxy and asked for a burst pricing estimate. Anyone can own?

Ishaan: I can take this. Are they on hosted POC?

Dana: Yes hosted. They may flip to Dedicated later.

Kara: Rust note: native TLS stacks will fail if the proxy replaces certs. Two pragmatic options: 1) Atlas allowlists our egress IPs; 2) for POC only, point the SDK at a CA bundle they install (env var). I'll paste a tiny tokio+tungstenite snippet: `use tokio_tungstenite::connect_async; async fn s(k:&str){ let (mut ws,_) = connect_async("wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=mini").await.unwrap(); ws.send("{\"prompt\":\"charge 9.99 to acct-55\"}").await.unwrap(); while let Some(m)=ws.next().await{println!("{}",m.unwrap());}}`

Kara: Tool JSON example we recommend: `{"tool":"charge_card","args":{"amount_cents":999,"currency":"USD","trace_id":"atlas-2026-0500"}}` — validate with serde before calling payments.

Matt: If allowlist not feasible, we can issue a POC mTLS client cert or spin a staging edge outside their inspection. Also their proxy kills idle websockets (~30s). Add app pings every 10-15s.

Lina: Security quick: hosted uses AWS KMS (HSM-backed) by default; BYOK and on-prem HSM supported on Dedicated/Private. SOC2 Type II docs and SAML/OIDC config available. I'll DM the packet.

Omar: Pricing quickball: hosted bursts (1k TPS spikes, ~120 tokens avg) ~= $17k-$28k/mo; Dedicated (sustained 1k TPS) ~= $50k-$75k/mo. I'll run a spreadsheet once they share samples.

deploy-bot: Provisioned `atlascorp-poc-staging` with key `REDS_STAGE_20605` (expires 24h).

Dana: Thanks everyone 94 scheduling a sync with Atlas infra tomorrow 11am PT. Ishaan & Kara please join; I'll send invite and attach a short runbook.
